notes.title: Posing Tool Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451255/7b5de2a0bdba7c8334a42b7e5b90eb4d2f9b137a.jpg[/img]

Made a few changes to how the posable characters work. Firstly they don't work like a traditional bone system. Instead the bones are using IK to position themselves according to the target points that are now highlighted as black "Nodes" the head now has a visible line guiding to the head target node. Pulling the remaining nodes away also creates a line showing where the constraints start for the limits of the bones. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451255/afe64a8b3d78666b6296a51249a4f9cf9f357cc6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hot Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Specter Hot Fixes[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451255/4d8bb02811a1b9a5684181f186b8cfa9e1e9f972.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Added the ability to add scene objects in front of the camera by holding Left Shift and clicking the element you want to add.
[*] Added UI button on the main toolbar for resetting Camera position.
[*] Camera now resets when starting a new scene or loading an existing scene.
[*] Made a few updates to the IK Posable Characters. The elbow's and knee's now have bending support. You can now "Dab".
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451255/2a6b39fc4c46d24b00bd11f7327118b5bc0fb00b.jpg[/img]

Thanks!

notes.title: Specter Alpha 1.0.0 now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451255/784c029e7ed454a33ed2d96a1d89d87be96ccede.jpg[/img]

[b]Specter is now live and is free to use.[/b] 

This tool is really all about quickly throwing together visual ideas for pre production compositions, or artists who want to easily block out a frame for a paintover. 

It started as a small internal idea and we built this alpha version to experiment with, and rather than letting it sit idly in one of our project folders we decided to share it in Early Access to see if there is any interest to continue development. 

Let us know if you are using it by communicating with us in our discussion boards. 

Thanks!
